Recent notes

  • A and C angles: in-situ calibration before the re-pass 2026-10-08TrackingCalibration

    The in-situ (is2) bundles close A within ±4 % on cosmic truth and read in-beam muons right to 1–4 %; production was 10–20 % steep. Before the is2_v1 re-pass: a raw-tan cut in the fit cuts C's angular reach from 0.97 to 0.58; open problems and the small checks to do first.

  • Calorimetry feasibility: what the stack can measure 2026-10-08X17ScintillatorsCalibrationGeant4

    Plastic scale 3-24 % low at the muon (fixed), liquids threshold-limited, MM dE/dx and the soft-leg energy discriminant both killed (+5-8 % against IPC).

  • LNL ⁸Be feasibility: MX17 on a proton beam 2026-10-08LnlFeasibility

    Could the MX17 apparatus repeat the ATOMKI ⁷Li(p,e⁺e⁻)⁸Be measurement at LNL? Geant4: 3σ at the ATOMKI ratio in ~16 days at 1 µA as built, ~1.2 days with big plastics.

  • MX17 papers: the two-paper plan 2026-10-08DetectorPaper

    The detector paper split into two companions (detector & performance; reconstruction with a hits-vs-waveforms comparison): outlines, work left, order of work, n_TOF tripwires.

  • Beam-off cosmics: n_TOF clock and the beam angle scale 2026-10-07BackgroundsCosmicsTiming

    Beam-off cosmics matched to n_TOF without beam (92 % within ±50 ns), then used to settle the beam angle scale: cosmics at A's wall read 1.15, beam 0.89; in-beam muons and Geant4 show the gap is electron scattering, not reconstruction. Plus: gain, the A–C cosmic rate, the late-trigger clock, activation.

  • Two tracks in one plane: the real limit, and how close we get 2026-10-07ReconstructionTwo-track

    Physical limit ~1 strip pitch, real-track limit 2–3 mm; an opt-in chain takes close pairs from 0 to ~50 % and passes the real-trigger contract at F = 1200 / 2400. The single-track seeder, drift velocity and angle scale under it are being recalibrated on cosmics.
